_comment: Judge registry for E1-v2. Identity (deployment, model id, API version) and credentials come from the environment ONLY; this file names the variables, never their values. Request parameters are per judge because reasoning-model deployments reject a temperature override and take max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens. Every request parameter here can be overridden by the matching *_TEMPERATURE / *_TOKEN_PARAM / *_MAX_TOKENS / *_REASONING_EFFORT / *_SEED / *_SAMPLES environment variable (value 'none' omits the parameter). The exact parameters sent are recorded on every verdict.
_prompt_versions: e1v2-r3 (rubrics/e1v2-r3/*.txt, core facts) is current; e1v2-r2 (every key fact) and e1v2-reasoned-strip-r1 (built in judges.py) are kept to reproduce the earlier d2_support dev gradings. Select with label.py --rubric.

spend._note: Spend ledger: llm/experiment1_v2/spend.py (python -m llm.experiment1_v2.spend). Ledger path: VOICE_RAG_JUDGE_LEDGER, default the main checkout's llm/experiment1_v2/results/_spend_ledger.json (shared by all worktrees).

primary.label: gpt6
primary._note: GPT-6.1-sol on Azure (deployment and api version from env; 2025-04-01-preview verified). It is a reasoning model: max_tokens and any non-default temperature are rejected, so temperature is never sent and sampling is stochastic. reasoning_effort and seed are pinned and each answer is graded by `samples` independent draws (seed, seed+1, ...) with a majority vote; every draw is recorded so self-consistency can be reported. The completion budget covers reasoning tokens.

budget._note: HARD CAP (PI): INR 20,000 total for GPT-6.1-Sol across all its deployments. Baseline = Azure metrics for gpt-6.1-sol + gpt-6.1-sol-dz up to 2026-10-16 ($88.85 at the prices below).

secondary.label: gpt4o-v4
secondary._note: The validated v4 'reasoned + strip' judge used for the real E3 sweep (azure-openai/gpt-4o@2025-01-01-preview). Falls back to the AZURE_OPENAI_* variables the E3 runner reads.

budget._note: Tracked and reported only (no cap unless VOICE_RAG_JUDGE2_CAP_INR is set). No baseline was provided for earlier gpt-4o spend.
